title: Corvid tool-calling golden case (C-034)
description: One line of evals/tool-calling/cases.jsonl. For editors and the docs: Corvid.Evals.ToolCalling.ToolCallingSet.Load enforces the same rules by hand, plus the ones a schema cannot state (expected tools are in catalogue.json, constrained parameters are declared by an expected tool, equals and enum values lie inside a declared enum, ids are unique).

prompt.description: The user message, sent as the turn's only message.

steps.description: A multi-step case: the calls expected, in order.

results.description: Canned result text by tool name; a tool without one returns {"ok":true}.

note.description: Provenance or why the label is what it is.

args.description: One constraint per parameter. With any_of, a constraint applies to the called tool only when that tool declares the parameter.

equals.description: Strings compare trimmed and case-insensitively (S5's rule); numbers and booleans exactly.

regex.description: .NET regular expression, case-insensitive, matched against the value's text.

present.description: The argument is given and not null.
